name: path-hubs
description:
Group Chat and Code sessions under one hub per git repo path.

Claude Code cannot inject a sidebar. /path-hubs renders the 2a Path hubs view (Chats, Code, Unlinked, auto-link). SessionStart auto-links the current cwd when the toggle is on. Manual link and unlink persist.

status line; commands: /path-hubs, /path-hubs-auto-off, /path-hubs-auto-on, /path-hubs-link, /path-hubs-unlink; SessionStart hook.
